text:
rachel_sales: Heads up — TerraForge POC kickoff. Customer asks to run our adapter against their custom TerraForge-34B model variant. Need compatibility check + pricing estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted. Also they sent a security questionnaire. Can eng help?:wave:

tyler_eng_ml: Quick Q — do they need KV cache support and dense KV quantization? TerraForge variants sometimes change tokenizer and KV layout.

rachel_sales: Yes KV cache matters, latency SLO = 150ms p95 for 512-token contexts. They prefer q8_0 for cost but can consider q4_0 if accuracy drops.

sana_eng_platform: Re: tokenizer — ask them to confirm tokenizer name/hash. If it's a non-standard BPE, we may need a tokenizer adapter. Also need the model HF or archive URL.

lee_solutions: Can you drop their questionnaire link here? I can spin up a preflight checklist for onboarding and estimate ops time.

rachel_sales: Link: https://files.company/terraforge/poc-security-questionnaire.pdf Please check PCI/data residency Q7 and KMS key usage.

mike_sales_ops: For pricing, baseline: Hosted = pay-as-you-go; Dedicated = reserved pool w/ monthly commit. Rough delta for 34B (q8) -> Dedicated savings ~30-40% at steady throughput. I'll draft numbers once eng confirms batch sizes.

tyler_eng_ml: Compatibility notes: if variant uses rotary embeddings or custom RMSNorm placement, we need an adapter pass. I can run a quick model scan if they provide the tarball. Command for them to run (or we can):
```
scripts/model-scan.sh --input terraforge-34b.tar.gz --output scan.json
```
This gives tokenizer, kv-layout, rms/norm flags.

sana_eng_platform: Ops blockers: KMS integration — we require a customer-managed KMS or temporary escrow key for Private. For Dedicated we can support bring-your-own-key with proper ACLs. Also need to know if logs contain prompt tokens for compliance.

lee_solutions: Action items: 1) Tyler to run scan (or share scan command with customer). 2) Rachel to collect questionnaire answers and tokenizer/hash. 3) Mike to draft Dedicated vs Hosted cost delta. 4) Sana to confirm KMS feasibility and data flows.

tyler_eng_ml: I'll queue the scan — ETA 24h once we have tarball. If they can't share tarball, ask for HF model id + config.json and tokenizer files.

rachel_sales: I'll ping customer for tarball + answers. Also asked about SLA — they need 99.9% uptime and regional deployment in eu-west-1. Is that covered?

sana_eng_platform: EU region + 99.9% SLA is fine for Dedicated. Hosted may need enterprise plan and cross-region routing; needs sales approval.

mike_sales_ops: Noted. I'll prep a pricing slide for tomorrow's sync and include a quick TCO calc for 3-month POC vs 12-month commit.

secbot: SECURITY CHECK — flagged question Q7 (data residency) and Q12 (KMS key rotation). Security team: please review attached questionnaire and reply in-thread within 48h. :lock:

lee_solutions: Thanks. If anyone wants a template for the onboarding runbook, I have a template (adapter-checklist.md) I can share.

rachel_sales: Great — thanks all. I'll update thread when customer replies. :thumbsup:
